st_title: Thirty years of Korean charcoal BBQ.
st_p: “AnnanGol” joins the “Annan” of Annandale with “gol.” In Korean, “gol” first meant a valley; as people settled in the valleys, it came to mean a small mountain village. Like a village where neighbors gather to share a meal, we still welcome every guest at the charcoal grill.
